name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
shortDescription: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments to small and marginal farmer families across India.
fullDescription: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land-holding farmer families.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into bank account
applicationProcedure: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land details and Aadhaar verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban & Gramin (PMAY)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
shortDescription: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh on home loans for EWS, LIG and MIG categories to ensure pucca houses for all.
fullDescription: PMAY aims to address urban and rural housing shortage among the EWS/LIG and MIG categories including the slum dwellers by ensuring a 'pucca' house to all eligible urban and rural households.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans
Direct subsidy grant up to ₹2.67 Lakhs
applicationProcedure: Register on pmaymis.gov.in or submit application through primary lending institutions (banks/HFCs).

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
shortDescription: Financial assistance up to ₹50 Lakh for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry.
fullDescription: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) aims to provide financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialization.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakh grant for prototype validation
Up to ₹50 Lakh convertible debentures / debt linked investment
applicationProcedure: Apply directly on the Startup India portal by selecting preferred incubators.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
shortDescription: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum to meritorious students of economically weaker sections from Class IX to XII.
fullDescription: The Centrally Sponsored Scheme 'National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)' aims to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII.
benefits: Direct payment into student's bank account
applicationProcedure: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) following state selection test.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
shortDescription: Maternity benefit of ₹6,000 for pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second live child.
fullDescription: PMMVY is a Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme under which cash incentive of ₹5,000 is provided directly to the Bank / Post Office Account of Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers.
applicationProcedure: Register at Anganwadi Centre or apply online via pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
shortDescription: Monthly pension support for senior citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
fullDescription: Under IGNOAPS, financial assistance is provided to BPL persons aged 60 years and above with monthly pension contributions co-shared by Central and State Governments.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹500 - ₹3,000 depending on state top-up
Higher pension rate for seniors above 80 years
Direct Benefit Transfer into bank/post office
applicationProcedure: Submit application at Block Development Office (BDO) or District Social Welfare Office.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
shortDescription: Health coverage of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled hospitals.
fullDescription: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of Rs 5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor families.
benefits: ₹5 Lakh free health cover per family per year
Cashless treatment at empanelled public & private hospitals
Covers pre and post hospitalization expenses
No family size or age limit restriction
applicationProcedure: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in and generate Ayushman Card at any empanelled hospital.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
shortDescription: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to at least one member of every rural household.
fullDescription: MGNREGA aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Equal wages for men and women
Unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days
Work provided within 5 km of residence
applicationProcedure: Apply at Gram Panchayat office for Job Card issuance.

name: Mazi Ladki Bahin Yojana
department: Department of Women & Child Development, Govt of Maharashtra
shortDescription: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month directly credited to eligible women in Maharashtra.
fullDescription: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana aims to empower women economically by providing monthly financial support of ₹1,500 to women aged 21-65 years with annual family income under ₹2.5 Lakh.
applicationProcedure: Apply via Nari Shakti Doot App or Setu Suvidha Kendra.

name: Chief Minister Abhyudaya Yojana
department: Social Welfare Dept, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
shortDescription: Free competitive exam coaching (UPSC, UPPSC, NEET, JEE) along with free tablets for meritorious youth.
fullDescription: CM Abhyudaya Scheme provides free physical and online coaching by IAS, IPS, and expert officers to aspirants preparing for competitive examinations.
applicationProcedure: Register at abhyuday.up.gov.in and clear entrance assessment.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
department: Special Programme Implementation Dept, Tamil Nadu
shortDescription: Monthly rights grant of ₹1,000 to female heads of families in Tamil Nadu.
fullDescription: A flagship scheme recognizing the uncompensated labor of women, granting ₹1,000 monthly to over 1.15 crore eligible women in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Direct credit on 15th of every month
applicationProcedure: Apply at special camps organized across Tamil Nadu public distribution outlets.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
shortDescription: Crop loss compensation up to ₹25,000 per hectare without requiring premium payment from farmers.
fullDescription: Replaces traditional crop insurance to provide zero-cost compensation for drought, unseasonal rainfall, and flood crop damages in Gujarat.
